text: The initiative proposes five pilot schemes tailored to PRC's public finance needs, emphasizing market-based parametric insurance with objective triggers for rapid liquidity. It critiques the limitations of current fiscal reserves and indemnity insurance, advocating for a blend of instruments. The proposal aligns with agricultural insurance modernization and potential public-private partnership structures, focusing on rapid, rules-based liquidity. It also integrates sectoral risk systems, particularly in agriculture, using technology and public-private pool structures to reduce basis risk and improve yield estimation.

metadata.solution_name: From Pandemic to Greater Resilience: Enhancing Disaster Risk Financing in the People’s Republic of China
